description: The rulebook for PORTING one official UI5 demo-kit sample to abap2UI5 as a z2ui5_cl_smpc_app_<n> class in the samples-controls corpus: what to do with the original Component.js/view.xml/controller, the corpus naming and file conventions, and the 1:1 fidelity rules its gates enforce. Use it when you are porting a named demo-kit sample. If you are building an app of your own, `app_guide` is the one you want — this document assumes an input sample you do not have and a corpus you are not writing into.
name: generation_rules
